item.title: Claude Code in Practice
item.description:
Simple definition#

Claude Code is Anthropic’s agentic coding tool. It reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands and integrates with your development tools — in the terminal, VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, a desktop app, the browser (cloud sessions), mobile, Slack and CI. It is a harness around a Claude model: the model reasons and decides; Claude Code supplies the tools, manages what goes into the context window, and enforces permissions.

item.title: Claude Across the SDLC
item.description:
Simple definition#

Using Claude across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) means giving it a defined job in each phase — not just autocomplete while coding. In every phase the pattern is the same: context in (the artefacts that phase needs), a specific task, a verification step, and a human decision where accountability sits.
